en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 26, 2026
en.description: Eight bounded actions distinguish a useful system from its headline inputs.
en.centralJudgment: Measure the whole job. The thermal essay and its idealized calculation are complete editorial artifacts. Proposed evaluations and diligence remain unexecuted; incomplete flows and future results stay open.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. Defined work. Honest completion.

actions.title: Specify a paired image test
actions.why: Local visual agents could help an OPC, but faster generation alone does not establish a cheaper reliable workflow.
steps: Record a paired ten-image evaluation specification comparing total latency and accepted answers with drafting on and off; execution remains pending, with no private images or production-routing change.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: READY; a ten-image specification is recorded; no benchmark executed.

actions.title: Save a perception supplier card
actions.why: This gives the robotics thesis a component-level decision object, distinct from humanoid shipment counts.
steps: Save a perception-supplier diligence card requiring closing confirmation, customer retention and gross-margin evidence before upgrading commercial confidence.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: READY; card records three evidence requirements; closing and economics unverified.

actions.domain: Crypto Capital Flows and Web3 Health
actions.title: Retain the incomplete-flow watchpoint
actions.why: The preceding ETF narrative should not accumulate confidence merely because another day has passed.
steps: Keep the standing flow watchpoint unchanged until all constituent reports are present and the total is reconciled; require independent activity evidence before any broad Web3-health conclusion.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: WATCHING; constituent completeness and independent activity evidence remain required.

actions.title: Separate proposed and final rules
actions.why: Payments experience becomes useful at the boundary between the ledger, the regulated entity and the party accountable for redemption.
steps: Save one proposed-versus-final rules checklist for Board-supervised issuers, keeping implementation dates unfilled until the relevant final text is published.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: READY; checklist scope saved; final rule and implementation date UNKNOWN.

actions.title: Publish The Heat Bill in Space
actions.why: This connects engineering and capital judgment through a mechanism readers can inspect.
steps: Publish “The Heat Bill in Space” (Chinese working title, translated: “The Heat Bill in Space”) at [today's canonical Action Item](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202609/20260926/action_item/). Thesis: orbital AI must turn electrical power into reliable useful output while paying for heat rejection. Evidence spine: announced versus completed tests; the radiator constraint; an idealized one-megawatt calculation; lifecycle and workload economics; a bounded evidence card. Use Google, NASA and ESA primary sources, and archive a LinkedIn derivative with the explanatory thermal diagram.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: COMPLETE as an editorial artifact; public delivery has separate release gates.
actions.deepDiveTitle: Publish The Heat Bill in Space

actions.domain: AI Infrastructure, Career and Capital Projects
actions.title: Record orbital test evidence requirements
actions.why: Power-to-work conversion is an infrastructure underwriting skill and a useful career research wedge; this announcement does not establish a job opening.
steps: Save a public-evidence milestone card requiring in-orbit workload duration, thermal limits, error recovery and delivered output before advancing the project beyond experimental status.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: READY; milestone specification saved; orbital observations not yet established.

actions.title: Keep Confido at WATCH
actions.why: Cash application and deductions connect agentic software to familiar payments and reconciliation problems.
steps: WATCH; upgrade to INVESTIGATE only after cohort retention, gross margin after service labor, verified customer savings, preference terms and accessible allocation are evidenced.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: WATCHING; diligence and access conditions unpassed.

actions.title: Freeze the Jabil pre-results card
actions.why: A manufacturer offers a different test of the AI buildout from a model developer or a neocloud.
steps: Save a pre-results card requiring disclosed AI-related demand, segment profitability and working-capital cash effects before changing the investment thesis; do not infer a price target or trade.
Keep the source date and attribution with each observation. Record completion only when the stated evidence exists.
actions.done: WATCHING; questions saved before September 30; no results assumed.
